desc: Implement a solution that reads T test cases, where each case consists of N and the sequence A.
For each test case, identify the distinct values present in A and sort them based on the index of their first occurrence to determine the processing order.

Iterate through these sorted distinct values, maintaining a count of "active" elements (those not yet deleted) encountered so far. For each value, add the count of active elements preceding it to the total swap cost, then add 1 to the total cost for the deletion operation, and update the active count by subtracting the number of occurrences of the current value.
Print the calculated minimum total operations for each test case on a new line.
Ensure the code handles input/output efficiently given the constraints (sum of N up to 2e5) using fast I/O methods in Python.

Implement the greedy solution using a Fenwick tree (Binary Indexed Tree) to efficiently calculate the number of active elements preceding each group of identical values, then sum the costs and print the results.
